sentences.text: Applicant has filed this revision under Section 397 read with Section 401 of Code of Criminal Procedure challenging framing of charges under Sections 304, 308, 420, 467, 468, 471 of Indian Penal Code read with 146/196, 56/192 read with 39 and 184 of Motor Vehicles Act.

2. As per prosecution story, on 07.10.2022, one loading auto bearing registration No.
MP-04-LD-5903 dashed one motorcycle which was standing in the roadside and also dashed one boy and one woman, who were standing nearby the motorcycle.
After accident, auto entered into the field and stopped.
Driver ran away from spot.
Three persons died as the result of accident.
Driver of vehicle was one Chhotelal Ahirwar.
During investigation, it was found that auto is using number plate which does not match chassis and engine number.
Auto was being driven by using a fake registration number on it.
3. Counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is owner of loading auto and she has not committed any offence.
She could not be made NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:56235 2 CRR-3132-2024 vicariously liable for offences under Sections 304 and 308 of Indian Penal Code.
It is further submitted that offences under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC is also not made out against the applicant.

sentences.text: Diesel model from Sanghi Brothers, Bhopal and was doing supply of Balaji Namkin and Wafers in city and nearby.
Auto was having CDPF and SDPF fault.
Several complaints were made, but said fault could not be removed.
On 04.07.2022 registered notice was sent to the company for replacement of vehicle.
Company agreed for replacement of vehicle and issued invoice on 31.08.2022.

It is submitted that on 06.09.2022, loading auto was sent for replacement and the body was having registration No. MP-04-LD- 5903 painted at the backside was removed from loading auto at body building place.
On 22.09.2022, Sanghi Brothers gave new loading auto and body detachable box of old auto was fixed with new auto.
On said body detachable box, old registration number was painted, hence, it was covered by tape and board.
At the time of accident, covered portion got removed and old registration number started appearing at the backside of detachable box.
Temporary registration number could not be given due to heavy rush.
It is also submitted that even if applicant is using registration number of some other auto, then also offences under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of IPC is not made out.
In these circumstances, no case is made out.
4. Government Advocate appearing for respondent/State opposed the prayer for quashing of charges.
It is submitted by him that new auto was purchased by applicant.
On said auto, registration number of old auto was being used and vehicle was being plied.
Said act of applicant has caused wrongful loss and since registration number of some other vehicle has been used, therefore, said number was forged and fabricated on the auto.

In these circumstances, offences are made NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:56235 3 CRR-3132-2024 out and no error has been committed by the trial Court in framing charges against the applicant under aforesaid Sections of Indian Penal Code.
Revision application be dismissed.
5. Heard the counsel for the parties.

6. Forgery is defined in Section 463 of IPC which is reproduced as under:-
"463 Forgery .-[Whoever makes any false documents or false electronic record or part of a document or electronic record, with intent to cause damage or injury], to the public or to any person, or to support any claim or title, or to cause any person to part with property, or to enter into any express or implied contract, or with intent to commit fraud or that fraud may be committed, commits forgery."

7. Punishment for forgery is described in Section 465 of IPC which is reproduced as under:-
"465. Punishment for forgery .- Whoever commits forgery shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both."
8.

False document is described in Section 464 of IPC which is reproduced as under:-

First -- Who dishonestly or fraudulently-- (a) makes, signs, seals or executes a document or part of a document;
(b) makes or transmits any electronic record or part of any electronic record;

Secondly -- Who, without lawful authority, dishonestly or fraudulently,
by cancellation or otherwise, alters a document or an electronic record in any material part thereof, after it has been made, executed or affixed with electronic signature either by himself or by any other person, whether such person be living or dead at the time of such alteration; or Thirdly -- Who dishonestly or fraudulently causes any person to sign, seal, execute or alter a document or an electronic record or to affix his electronic signature on any electronic record knowing that such person NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:56235 4 CRR-3132-2024 by reason of unsoundness of mind or intoxication cannot, or that by reason of deception practised upon him, he does not know the contents of the document or electronic record or the nature of the alteration.]"
9. Section 24 'dishonestly' and Section 25 'fraudulently' is also relevant in the case, therefore, quoted as under:-
"24.

"Dishonestly" .-- Whoever does anything with the intention of causing wrongful gain to one person or wrongful loss to another person, is said to do that thing "dishonestly".
25.
"Fraudulently" .-- A person is said to do a thing fraudulently if he does that thing with intent to defraud but not otherwise."
10. On going through aforesaid provisions of law, it becomes clear that forgery is said to have been done when a person makes a false document.
A person, who makes a document by sign, seal or affixes his mark, is said to have created a document.
The term fraudulently is wider than the word dishonestly.
An act can be said to have been done fraudulently if same is done to cause injury or harm to body, mind or reputation.
11. On going through aforesaid provisions of law, it is clear that number plate was being used fraudulently.
Registration number which is being allotted to a vehicle is to be painted on number plate or a number plate having said registration number is to be affixed on the auto.

sentences.text: It is submitted by the counsel for the applicant that no false document has been created by applicant in affixing the said number plate.
Documentation is done by R.T.O. and registration number is allotted.
Registration number, which was not allotted to the auto, has fraudulently been used on the auto.

By doing the said act, fees and taxes prescribed under Motor Vehicles Act has not been paid by applicant and wrongful gains has been caused to applicant and wrongful loss has been caused to the State Government.

In view of same, it cannot be said that offences under Sections 420,
467, 468 and 471 of Indian Penal Code and under Sections 146/196, 56/192 r/w 39 and 184 of Motor Vehicles Act are not made out NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:56235 5 CRR-3132-2024 against the applicant.

12. Applicant being the owner of vehicle is duty bound to see that all requisite permissions, licenses,
permits are there in the vehicle for plying it on the road.
In any forgery or fraudulent act has been committed in respect of documentation or assigning number plate on the auto, then vehicle owner is responsible for same.
However, owner will not be responsible for rash and negligent act of driver which caused the accident.
Therefore, trial Court had committed an error in framing charges under Sections 304 and 308 of Indian Penal Code against the applicant.
13. In aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, revision is partly allowed.
Charges framed under Sections 304 and 308 of Indian Penal Code against the applicant are quashed.
Rest of the charges framed against the applicant are affirmed.
14. Revision petition is disposed off.
